Related to sol, Sol, Surya, and Helios. More at solar.

senses.definition: To sit, lie, or rest in the sunshine to relax or darken your skin.

examples.en: They spent the afternoon sunning themselves by the swimming pool.
examples.vi: Họ dành cả buổi chiều để tắm nắng bên hồ bơi.

senses.definition: To leave an object in the sunshine so it becomes dry or warm.
